newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen mixed over budget uncertainty.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen mixed over budget uncertainty.

text.p: Dhaka stocks are expected to remain mixed on Thursday amid uncertainty over fiscal policies in the new government budget to be announced later in the day, brokers said.

"The investors will certainly be looking at what support the budget will bring in for the capital market," said broker Mahbub Morshed. Brokers expect volume to drop further. The Dhaka Stock Exchange all-share price index closed little changed at 1,145.29 on turnover of 49.6 million taka on Wednesday.
